faqs.question: Can the CTFA unit operate in rooms without central HVAC?

faqs.question: How often do the HEPA filters need replacement?

items.seoTitle: Active Bipolar Ionisation System | In-Room Disinfection | IntelliGreen
items.seoDescription: Active Bipolar Ionisation technology replicating nature's air purification model. Ozone-free, energy efficient, and universal central HVAC system integration.
items.overview: Nature purifies mountain, forest, and post-rain ocean air through a natural balance of positive and negative ions. In modern cities and centralized air-conditioned buildings, ion density drops sharply, causing indoor air to feel dense and stale. The Active Bipolar Ionisation System replicates nature’s air purification model using Plasma Ionization technology. By releasing millions of balanced positive (H+) and negative (O2-) ions into the room, it actively neutralizes airborne viruses, bacteria, VOCs, and mold throughout 100% of the breathing zone. Designed for seamless integration into any HVAC system, it operates as a central, filterless air purifier.

workingMechanism.title: Natural Plasma Generation
workingMechanism.description: Replicates nature's purification process by splitting water vapor into balanced streams of positive (H+) and negative (O2-) ions.

workingMechanism.title: Active In-Room Disinfection
workingMechanism.description: Ions travel throughout the entire space, actively attacking airborne viruses, bacteria, mold spores, and toxic VOCs at their source.

workingMechanism.title: Agglomeration & HVAC Integration
workingMechanism.description: Causes ultrafine particles to cluster together for easy capture by ventilation systems, operating seamlessly with any HVAC setup.

technicalSpecifications.System Integration: AHUs, Ductwork, VRF/VRV Units & Standalone Duct Systems
technicalSpecifications.Pathogens Inactivated: Viruses, Bacteria, Mold Spores, VOCs & Odors

faqs.question: Why is Plasma Ionization described as '180 degrees opposite' to traditional purifiers?
faqs.answer: Traditional purifiers are passive—air must be sucked into a physical box to be filtered. Bipolar Ionisation is active—it floods the living space with natural ions to kill pathogens right where you breathe.

faqs.question: Can this system be installed into existing central HVAC ductwork?
faqs.answer: Yes, IntelliGreen ionisation units integrate seamlessly into AHUs, ductwork, FCUs, or VRF systems to turn your existing HVAC into a central air purifier.

items.seoTitle: EAC Electronic Air Cleaner Filter | GreenPro Certified | IntelliGreen
items.seoDescription: CII–IGBC GreenPro Certified EAC Electronic Air Cleaner featuring dual-stage electrostatic precipitation. MERV 15+ efficiency for sub-micron particles with washable cells.
features: Captures Smoke, Mold Spores, Bacteria & Sub-Micron Dust
Ultra-Low Airflow Pressure Drop (Saves HVAC Energy)
items.overview: The EAC Electronic Air Cleaner relies on fundamental principles of Electrostatic Precipitation to deliver high-capacity micro-particle collection without restricting HVAC airflow. Engineered with a dual-stage setup featuring an initial Charging Section and a subsequent Collector Section, airborne particles are positively charged and attracted to oppositely charged collection plates. It removes a broad spectrum of airborne contaminants—including dust, pollen, mold spores, bacteria, smoke, haze, and sub-micron particles—with filtration performance equivalent to MERV 15 or higher, yet with a significantly lower pressure drop compared to conventional mechanical filters. Officially GreenPro certified by CII–IGBC (Confederation of Indian Industry – Indian Green Building Council).

workingMechanism.title: Charging Section (Ionizing Stage)
workingMechanism.description: Airborne contaminants pass through high-voltage ionizing wires, imparting a positive electrical charge to fine dust, pollen, bacteria, and smoke particles.

workingMechanism.title: Collector Section (Electrostatic Capture)
workingMechanism.description: Charged particles enter an intense electrostatic field between oppositely charged aluminum collection plates, trapping micro-pollutants down to sub-micron sizes.

workingMechanism.title: Low Resistance Airflow Circulation
workingMechanism.description: Purified air passes through with minimal static pressure drop, maintaining optimum HVAC energy efficiency with zero disposable filter waste.

technicalSpecifications.Environmental Certification: GreenPro Certified by CII–IGBC (Indian Green Building Council)
technicalSpecifications.Contaminants Removed: Dust, Pollen, Mold Spores, Bacteria, Tobacco Smoke, Haze & PM0.3
technicalSpecifications.Maintenance: Washable Metal Cells (No Disposable Filter Replacements)
technicalSpecifications.HVAC Compatibility: AHU Ductwork, Return Air Ducts & FCU Integration

faqs.question: What is GreenPro Certification by CII-IGBC?
faqs.answer: GreenPro certification by CII–IGBC validates that the EAC filter meets stringent environmental standards, reducing building HVAC energy consumption and eliminating disposable filter waste.

faqs.question: How does electrostatic precipitation compare to standard HEPA filters?
faqs.answer: Unlike dense mechanical HEPA filters that obstruct airflow and strain HVAC fans, EAC electrostatic cells capture sub-micron particles at MERV 15+ efficiency with ultra-low static pressure resistance (<25 Pa), saving up to 30% fan energy.

The IAQ Smart Sensor Station empowers clients to independently select and customize monitoring parameters tailored to their local environmental conditions. Equipped with multi-channel communication protocols—including Wi-Fi, MODBUS, GPRS, and long-range LoRaWAN—it delivers precision telemetry beyond conventional market standards. faqs.question: How does LoRaWAN connectivity benefit large multi-floor facility deployments?
faqs.answer: LoRaWAN provides ultra-long-range wireless signal penetration through thick concrete walls and multiple building floors with minimal power, eliminating complex ethernet duct wiring.
